#!/bin/ash

apk update
apk add curl unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
touch user_jvm_args.txt

if [ "$BUILD_VERSION" == "babric" ]; then
    curl -SL -o BTA_Babric_$BTA_VERSION.zip "https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-fabric-instance-repo/releases/download/v$BTA_VERSION/bta_fabric_server_$BTA_VERSION.zip"

    echo "-Dfabric.runtimeMappingNamespace=official" > user_jvm_args.txt
elif [ "$BUILD_VERSION" == "release" ]; then
    curl -SL -O "https://downloads.betterthanadventure.net/bta-server/release/v$BTA_VERSION/server.jar"
else
    curl -SL -O "https://downloads.betterthanadventure.net/bta-server/$BUILD_VERSION/$BTA_VERSION/server.jar"
fi

echo -e "Install Complete"
